intro: EPUB to MOBI converts e-books in EPUB format into MOBI to read them on Amazon Kindle devices and the Kindle app. The MOBI format is Amazon's: MOBI is the classic format every Kindle understands, including the oldest ones; you can send it to your Kindle by cable or with “Send to Kindle”.

To go from EPUB to MOBI we use Calibre, the reference free e-book program, which keeps chapters, the table of contents, the cover, images, styles and metadata (title, author, language and publisher). If you like, you can set another title or author in the advanced options, for example when the book carries the file name instead of the real title.

Before converting we check the EPUB file: that it is not damaged, that it does not link files outside the book itself and that it has no DRM. Books bought with copy protection cannot be converted, and we tell you without trying; DRM-free books, public domain books and books you made yourself convert without trouble.

Conversion to MOBI runs on our server, with Calibre as a separate program, without internet access and with limited time and memory. You can convert several EPUB books at once and download them in a ZIP; they are deleted when they expire.
steps: Upload one or more EPUB books.
Optionally, change the title or author in the advanced options.
Download the book as MOBI or the ZIP.

faq.q: Why does it say my book has DRM?
faq.a: Because the shop sells it with copy protection. That encryption prevents turning it into MOBI; download it in that format from the shop, if it offers it.

faq.q: Is the table of contents kept?
faq.a: Yes, the table of contents and chapters carry over to MOBI, together with the cover and the EPUB metadata.

faq.q: What if I want the book as PDF?
faq.a: Use EPUB to PDF, which lays it out in pages with the paper, margins and font size you choose.
